title: Machine learning on synthetic MRI radiomics plus BI-RADS classifies breast masses
summary: In 43 lesions from 40 new patients, BI-RADS alone had AUC 0.667, a logistic regression model on synthetic MRI radiomics had AUC 0.707, and an ensemble integrating both reached AUC 0.883 (sensitivity 82.1%, specificity 86.7%). The ensemble AUC was significantly larger than the other two. The test set is small, single-center and retrospective.
ai_technology: Machine learning (logistic regression) on synthetic MRI radiomics combined with BI-RADS in an ensemble

evidence.tested: Held-out test set of 43 lesions separate from the 199-lesion cross-validation set.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies benign versus malignant breast masses

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
